strings.policy.eu-gdpr.summary: Health data is special-category data under GDPR Art. 9. We rely on your explicit consent to process it locally and for optional cloud, research, and AI features. You have rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability, and objection.

strings.policy.global-baseline.summary: Rianell stores health logs on your device by default. Cloud backup, anonymised research contribution, and on-device AI are optional and require separate consent. You can Exportar or Eliminar your data at any time.

strings.policy.other-jurisdictions-us-ca.summary: We do not sell personal information. California residents have rights to know, Eliminar, and correct personal information. Health logs are consumer wellness data, not HIPAA-covered provider records unless you use Rianell under a healthcare BAA.

strings.tutorial.slide0.body: ¿Quiere utilizar el análisis de inteligencia artificial (detección de patrones, obtención de información relevante y elaboración de resúmenes) y establecer objetivos y metas? Puede activar esta función más adelante en la sección de configuración.

Se utiliza para análisis y asesoramiento personalizados basados en la IA.
